items.title: Looted French goods are popping up on resale site Vinted
items.brief: The second-hand online marketplace Vinted has removed listings of looted French goods and stepped up checks on “suspicious” adverts, as the country’s authorities seek to prevent goods stolen during riots from being…

items.title: CNN warns Trump White House: Restore Air Force One access or face further legal action
items.brief: The White House has been excluding CNN from President Donald Trump’s trips on Air Force One, disrupting a decades-old tradition of pooled TV coverage.

items.title: Google Cloud services face outage in London, Revolut services down too
items.brief: Multiple Google Cloud services experienced disruptions in the company’s London region on Tuesday, according to its service status page, while British digital bank Revolut also reported a service outage.

items.title: UK to deploy fighter jets to defend Saudi Arabia against Houthi attacks
items.brief: The United Kingdom said Tuesday it will deploy fighter jets to defend Saudi Arabia against attacks by the Iran-allied Houthi rebels in Yemen.

items.title: Trump administration announces $8 billion farm relief plan as fuel, fertilizer costs bite
items.brief: President Donald Trump announced at a Kansas rally on Monday that his administration is introducing an $8 billion aid package for farmers in the face of high diesel and fertilizer costs.

items.title: Several French cities impose curfews after weekend of chaos and protests spreading to parts of Europe
items.brief: French officials are imposing localized curfews — including in parts of Paris — as the country grapples with the fallout from its worst rioting in years.
